title: The Previous Owners' Advent
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Our advent calendar came with the flat.
first_visual: A hand-painted advent calendar on a kitchen wall; door 1 open, a tiny painting of our building at night.

beats.visual: Hand opens door 1 of a painted advent calendar; inside, a tiny painting of the building at night.
beats.vo: Our advent calendar came with the flat.

beats.visual: Montage of doors opening: in each painting one more window is dark (post-animated paintings).
beats.vo: Each day, one more window in the painting went dark.

beats.visual: Ivy on Winter Lane looks up: the real windows are dark in the same pattern.
Painting 24: the whole building dark, a removal van, a new family looking up.
beats.vo: A removal van. A new family.

beats.visual: Painting 25: the new family's Christmas; at our window, Ivy and Theo, pale, lamp-eyed.
beats.vo: Their first Christmas. And at our window, us.

beats.visual: Ivy turns the calendar over: a list of family names crossed out; MARR not yet crossed; moth on the hanging string.
beats.vo: Every family stays. One way or another.

ending: On the back, a list of family names, each crossed out except the newest: MARR.
loop_note: No. It ends on the names list, a comment driver ('what happened to the others?').

originality_review: Original. An inherited advent calendar that forecasts residents becoming the building's watchers is our own invention. It is not tied to Krampus or any folklore figure. Seasonal timing: publish before 1 December (WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT).
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: An advent calendar left by the previous tenants paints the building one window darker each day. Behind door 25: the next family moving in, and at the upstairs window, Ivy and Theo, pale and watching.

hooks.line: Our advent calendar came with the flat.
hooks.first_visual: A hand-painted advent calendar on a kitchen wall; door 1 open, a tiny painting of our building at night.

hooks.line: Every door: one more window in our building goes dark.
hooks.first_visual: A row of open calendar doors, each painting darker.

hooks.line: Then the real windows matched the paintings.
hooks.first_visual: A real apartment block at night, windows going out.
A small finger prising open a numbered paper door.

hooks.line: Door twenty-five showed who'd be watching next year.
hooks.first_visual: Two pale faces at an upstairs window in a painting.

setting: Ivy's kitchen wall; Winter Lane facing Vesper Court, December.
conflict: Ivy dismisses it as a decoration until the real windows match.
escalation: The painted windows go dark, then the real ones, then Theo opens 24 early.
reveal: Door 25: a new family's first Christmas, and Ivy and Theo at the window, lamp-eyed.
emotional_objective: Festive dread; a 'universe' hook for winter (G3).
visual_requirements: calendar prop (painted doors animated in post)
